messages:
erin: Following the postmortem — proposal for a lightweight 'custody ledger' for postmortem actions. Purpose: keep custody explicit across IC swaps. Key pieces: primary custodian, backup custodian, custody expiry, minimal verification artifact, and short reminder cadence. Thoughts?

samir: Sounds clear. Can we make verification artifacts mandatory (dashboard link or smoke-run) before the ledger entry closes? Otherwise items slip.

jade: Add a recurrence flag on incidents. If same recurrence key appears 3 times in 60d, auto-create a 'recurrence review' ticket and attach the three PM summaries. Helps prioritize systemic fixes.

ollie: For IC rotation: add a one-line 'custody check' to handoff template. Incoming IC scans ledger for entries >48h and marks an "IC reviewer". That reviewer is a lightweight observer, not replacement owner.

erin: Draft custody ledger card:
```
custodian: @<name>
backup: @<name>
priority: P0/P1/P2
custody_expires: YYYY-MM-DD
verify: <dashboard or PR link>
recurrence_key: <service:error-hash>
blockers: short note
notes: rollback/ff link
```

samir: Comms cadence: when a ledger card is created, bot posts to #eng-oncall and service channel with one-line: "Custody <id> — custodian — ETA — blocker". Then 72h status pings until verification attached. Minimal noise.

followup-bot: [reminder] Custody 2326000001-1 due in 24h — pinging backup @jade.

jade: Pilot plan: infra-only, 3 weeks. Success metrics: median time-to-verify, % closed with artifact, # recurrence reviews opened. Demo 15m after week 1. I'll create board and README by Fri.

erin: I'll add the custody check to the oncall handoff doc and schedule the demo. Please post one-line updates here during the pilot: "Custody <id> — owner — status". Goal: fewer forgotten follow-ups and earlier detection of repeats. :rocket:
